description: Normal capture end: StreamEnded(502) push moves the session PLAYING -> READY.
preconditions: State PLAYING with stream instance 1; the capture ended normally (e.g. the Endpoint closed the stream).
assertions: Unsolicited push; detail absent (the spec names a detail only for the unsubscribe variant: 'unsubscribed' — see control.subscribe-config-diagnostics).
retryable=true is the §6.2 registry property of 502 (StreamEnded has no retryable wire field).
State PLAYING -> READY; media state for the instance is finalized and released.
